relevance_note: Four Chinese patients with SSADH deficiency and ALDH5A1 variants are described individually: "four Chinese patients were diagnosed with SSADH deficiency in Tianjin Children’s Hospital".
method_note: Built with a short Python script from my reading; Table 1 cells were typed by hand and checked against the table. Table 1 has patients as columns under the header 'Patients | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4' (= patient 1-4 of the text); spans quote the row label through the patient's cell. 'N' and 'Y' are defined in the Table 1 notes ('N no, Y yes'), quoted as a second span for exclusions; 'UN' (unknown) is not reported. Labels use the lowercase 'patient n' form, which the paper uses as often or more often than 'Patient n'. Relatives included: parents of all four patients (the paper states genetic testing of the parents and parent-of-origin statements), and the first baby of patient 2's mother, who 'died of convulsion at 23 days after birth' (relationship to patient 2 not otherwise stated; labelled by relation as written). Parents of patient 4 get no variant rows because the paper does not say which parent carries which variant; parents of patient 3 get c.800 T > G rows from 'which he inherited from his parents' (homozygous). Contradiction: patient 3 'developmental delay complicated with lack of sleep' vs Table 1 'Sleep disturbances' N; both rows emitted and the checklist item set to not reported. Note: patient 2 is reported homozygous for c.1529C > T while 'The healthy father did not carry the sequence variant'; recorded inheritance maternal per the stated maternal segregation. Table 1 'Convulsions' N for patients 3 and 4 was recorded as excluded convulsions but not as excluded 'seizures or epilepsy' (narrower absence). Polyphen2/SIFT predictions ('Probably damaging', 'Possibly damaging', 'disease causing') and conservation were not recorded as authors' pathogenicity classification or functional evidence; for patient 1 the two predictions are listed for two variants without explicit pairing. Variant type recorded only for c.1344-2delA ('intron splice site'). Transcript NM_170740 is the stated reference sequence for all sequencing. 'We have previously reported these two mutations [8, 12]' refers to mutations, not patients, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null. Ages in the case descriptions equal the Table 1 age of diagnosis, so they were recorded only as age at diagnosis. Patient 2's EEG (sleep spindle asynchrony) was marked as EEG abnormality on the basis of Table 1 'Abnormal EEG' Y; poor head control was mapped to gross motor deficits.
